name: Middle pool · south double iron gate, curved head and tiled planter
trust: Separate southern entrance, not the southwest steps of IMG_2333. IMG_2334 shows two open iron leaves below a shallow curved white rendered head with sparse metal pergola frame above, crazy paving and a flush drain. IMG_2335 shows the wall bench: a seat-height block recessed into the raised planter with a low plinth in front, below a tall white wall carrying a panel of white tiles framed with blue/yellow figure tiles. Corrected 18 October from a perspective reading of IMG_2334 (gate opening about 1.85 m as the scale): the right leaf opens back against about 1.7 m of planter, the bench recess runs about 1.7-2.7 m in from the gate line, and the planter continues past it towards the courtyard (modelled to about 3.1 m in, where the approximate mapped Calle Eva route turns north-west; its real courtyard end is not visible); the drain sits about 2.3-3.0 m in. Placement of the gate follows the gap between unchanged registry blocks, not GPS. Position (roughly 1-2 m), opening, heights, planter ends and bench dimensions are estimates (about ±0.3 m along the path); No grade change or enclosing wall beyond the photographed fragment is inferred. Tile motifs are schematic, not photo textures.

forecourt.name: Middle pool · bounded crazy-paved south forecourt
forecourt.trust: IMG_2334 shows continuous irregular grey/buff stone between the east hedge and west planter, continuing into the foreground; IMG_2335 confirms stone beside the bench. Draft bounded 5 m by 2.12 m rectangle in the unchanged gate frame; depth, width and straight limits are estimated, not traced enclosure boundaries. Aerial shadow/vegetation hide the exact ends and the Eva junction. Existing mapped route axes and terrain are retained. No surveyed placement approval.

hedge.name: Middle pool · visible east hedge fragment
hedge.trust: Tall clipped hedge at photo-left/east in IMG_2334. Only the gate-side fragment is drafted. Width, height and endpoints estimated; its hidden continuation is deliberately unresolved. Fragment stops before the mapped Eva crossing at along -2.99 m; this route clearance is not evidence of an actual gap in the hedge. Details-only cards, no wall or collision.

benchPlanting.trust: Columnar evergreen shrubs and geraniums flank the bench in the photographs. Roots are bounded estimates within the unchanged planter; full visible radii use the shared route guard. Any source plant conflicting with estimated Eva crossing is omitted rather than relocating the route.

cabinet.trust: Small pale vented cabinet face observed at courtyard end of the planter in IMG_2192. Appearance/attachment estimated on existing face; utility identity, contents and hidden services unknown. No new opening or walk obstacle.
